en.text: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

zhSimplified.text: 便雅悯的长子比拉，次子亚实别，三子亚哈拉，

zhTraditional.text: 便雅憫的長子比拉，次子亞實別，三子亞哈拉，

en.text: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

zhSimplified.text: 四子挪哈，五子拉法。

zhTraditional.text: 四子挪哈，五子拉法。

en.text: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

zhSimplified.text: 比拉的儿子是亚大、基拉、亚比忽、

zhTraditional.text: 比拉的兒子是亞大、基拉、亞比忽、

en.text: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

zhSimplified.text: 亚比书、乃幔、亚何亚、

zhTraditional.text: 亞比書、乃幔、亞何亞、

en.text: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

zhSimplified.text: 基拉、示孚汛、户兰。

zhTraditional.text: 基拉、示孚汛、戶蘭。

en.text: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

zhSimplified.text: 以忽的儿子作迦巴居民的族长，被掳到玛拿辖；

zhTraditional.text: 以忽的兒子作迦巴居民的族長，被擄到瑪拿轄；

en.text: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

zhSimplified.text: 以忽的儿子乃幔、亚希亚、基拉也被掳去。基拉生乌撒、亚希忽。

zhTraditional.text: 以忽的兒子乃幔、亞希亞、基拉也被擄去。基拉生烏撒、亞希忽。

en.text: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

zhSimplified.text: 沙哈连休他二妻户伸和巴拉之后，在摩押地生了儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 沙哈連休他二妻戶伸和巴拉之後，在摩押地生了兒子。

en.text: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

zhSimplified.text: 他与妻贺得同房，生了约巴、洗比雅、米沙、玛拉干、

zhTraditional.text: 他與妻賀得同房，生了約巴、洗比雅、米沙、瑪拉干、

en.text: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

zhSimplified.text: 耶乌斯、沙迦、米玛。他这些儿子都是族长。

zhTraditional.text: 耶烏斯、沙迦、米瑪。他這些兒子都是族長。

en.text: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

zhSimplified.text: 他的妻户伸给他生的儿子有亚比突、以利巴力。

zhTraditional.text: 他的妻戶伸給他生的兒子有亞比突、以利巴力。

en.text: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

zhSimplified.text: 以利巴力的儿子是希伯、米珊、沙麦。沙麦建立阿挪和罗德二城与其村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 以利巴力的兒子是希伯、米珊、沙麥。沙麥建立阿挪和羅德二城與其村莊。

en.text: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

zhSimplified.text: 又有比利亚和示玛是亚雅 居民的族长，是驱逐迦特人的。

zhTraditional.text: 又有比利亞和示瑪是亞雅崙居民的族長，是驅逐迦特人的。

en.text: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

zhSimplified.text: 亚希约、沙煞、耶利末、

zhTraditional.text: 亞希約、沙煞、耶利末、

en.text: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

zhSimplified.text: 西巴第雅、亚拉得、亚得、

zhTraditional.text: 西巴第雅、亞拉得、亞得、

en.text: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

zhSimplified.text: 米迦勒、伊施巴、约哈都是比利亚的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 米迦勒、伊施巴、約哈都是比利亞的兒子。

en.text: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

zhSimplified.text: 西巴第雅、米书兰、希西基、希伯、

zhTraditional.text: 西巴第雅、米書蘭、希西基、希伯、

en.text: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

zhSimplified.text: 伊施米莱、伊斯利亚、约巴都是以利巴力的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 伊施米萊、伊斯利亞、約巴都是以利巴力的兒子。

en.text: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

zhSimplified.text: 雅金、细基 利、撒底、

zhTraditional.text: 雅金、細基利、撒底、

en.text: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

zhSimplified.text: 以利乃、洗勒太、以列、

zhTraditional.text: 以利乃、洗勒太、以列、

en.text: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

zhSimplified.text: 亚大雅、比拉雅、申拉都是示每的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 亞大雅、比拉雅、申拉都是示每的兒子。

en.text: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

zhSimplified.text: 伊施班、希伯、以列、

zhTraditional.text: 伊施班、希伯、以列、

en.text: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯顿、细基利、哈难、

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯頓、細基利、哈難、

en.text: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

zhSimplified.text: 哈拿尼雅、以拦、安陀提雅、

zhTraditional.text: 哈拿尼雅、以攔、安陀提雅、

en.text: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

zhSimplified.text: 伊弗底雅、毗努伊勒都是沙煞的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 伊弗底雅、毗努伊勒都是沙煞的兒子。

en.text: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

zhSimplified.text: 珊示莱、示哈利、亚他利雅、

zhTraditional.text: 珊示萊、示哈利、亞他利雅、

en.text: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

zhSimplified.text: 雅利西、以利亚、细基利都是耶罗罕的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 雅利西、以利亞、細基利都是耶羅罕的兒子。

en.text: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 这些人都是著名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。

zhTraditional.text: 這些人都是著名的族長，住在耶路撒冷。

en.text: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

zhSimplified.text: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦；

zhTraditional.text: 在基遍住的有基遍的父親耶利。他的妻名叫瑪迦；

en.text: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

zhSimplified.text: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥、基士、巴力、拿答、

zhTraditional.text: 他長子是亞伯頓。他又生蘇珥、基士、巴力、拿答、

en.text: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

zhSimplified.text: 基多、亚希约、撒迦、米基罗。

zhTraditional.text: 基多、亞希約、撒迦、米基羅。

en.text: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

zhSimplified.text: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。

zhTraditional.text: 米基羅生示米暗。這些人和他們的弟兄在耶路撒冷對面居住。

en.text: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

zhSimplified.text: 尼珥生基士；基士生扫罗；扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达、伊施·巴力。

zhTraditional.text: 尼珥生基士；基士生掃羅；掃羅生約拿單、麥基舒亞、亞比拿達、伊施‧巴力。

en.text: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

zhSimplified.text: 约拿单的儿子是米力·巴力；米力·巴力生米迦。

footnotes.text: - 8:34 在撒母耳下四章四节是米非波设

zhTraditional.text: 約拿單的兒子是米力‧巴力；米力‧巴力生米迦。

footnotes.text: - 8:34 在撒母耳下四章四節是米非波設

en.text: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

zhSimplified.text: 米迦的儿子是毗敦、米勒、他利亚、亚哈斯；

zhTraditional.text: 米迦的兒子是毗敦、米勒、他利亞、亞哈斯；

en.text: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯生耶何阿达；耶何阿达生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威、心利；心利生摩撒；

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯生耶何阿達；耶何阿達生亞拉篾、亞斯瑪威、心利；心利生摩撒；

en.text: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

zhSimplified.text: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚的儿子是拉法；拉法的儿子是以利亚萨；以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。

zhTraditional.text: 摩撒生比尼亞；比尼亞的兒子是拉法；拉法的兒子是以利亞薩；以利亞薩的兒子是亞悉。

en.text: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

zhSimplified.text: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 亞悉有六個兒子，他們的名字是亞斯利干、波基路、以實瑪利、示亞利雅、俄巴底雅、哈難。這都是亞悉的兒子。

en.text: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

zhSimplified.text: 亚悉兄弟以设的长子是乌兰，次子耶乌施，三子是以利法列。

zhTraditional.text: 亞悉兄弟以設的長子是烏蘭，次子耶烏施，三子是以利法列。

en.text: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

zhSimplified.text: 乌兰的儿子都是大能的勇士，是弓箭手，他们有许多的子孙，共一百五十名，都是便雅悯人。

zhTraditional.text: 烏蘭的兒子都是大能的勇士，是弓箭手，他們有許多的子孫，共一百五十名，都是便雅憫人。
